answer: Put iris crypt pattern hash at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. Cloning 379 keys multiplies the price 379-fold: 43964 POA locked, or 5306 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. The marble sits in the mechanism itself, the jetty sits in the price of faking it, and the tundra sits in the record no template can forge. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
